title: 生物医学论文修改(中文)
description: Please take on the role of a professional expert in the field of medicine and biology and revise my text to make it more in the style of an academic paper and to improve the flow and coherence of the text. Translate text into Chinese for reply.
notes: 请以医学和生物学领域专家的身份，修改我的文章，使其更符合学术论文的风格，并改善文章的流畅性和连贯性。将文本翻译成中文进行回复
